name: navigation-delete
description: Delete Tradebee navigation after explicit cascade-delete confirmation.

language.description: Required exact enabled site language selected from languages-get. Every target ID must belong to this language.

id_list.description: Required array of 1-100 positive navigation IDs selected from navigation-read. Send an array even for one item.

confirmation.description: Required approval stating that first-level deletion cascades to children.

approved.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly approves this operation.

summary.description: Summary of the exact language and navigation ID list; it must acknowledge cascading child deletion.

output.description: API result with success and failure arrays.
